newsletters.title: SAPA PHILATEX Fourth Quarter 2026
newsletters.description: Fourth Quarter 2026 newsletter featuring the October-December meeting calendar, the October 9 stamp program 'Expertising Philatelics' by Jimmy Tomchesson of Philatelic Stamp Authentication and Grading (PSAG), the San Antonio TSDA Stamp Show on October 9-10, the SAPA Annual Blue-Chip Auction on December 11, the SAPA Holiday Party on December 18, a memorial to Steve Mabie ('In Fond Memory of Steve Mabie'), a feature article on Postal Note Stamps, and the upcoming TSDA show schedule.

featuredArticles.title: In Fond Memory of Steve Mabie
October 9 Stamp Program: Expertising Philatelics (Jimmy Tomchesson)
Mark Your Calendars for the San Antonio Stamp Show

highlights: In Fond Memory of Steve Mabie: Steve passed away peacefully on July 1, 2026; he served as SAPA treasurer from 2024 until 2026 and newsletter editor from 2024 until 2025 (page 2)
Complete October-December 2026 meeting schedule

October 9 Stamp Program: Jimmy Tomchesson of Philatelic Stamp Authentication and Grading (PSAG) presents 'Expertising Philatelics' - how stamps are expertised, which stamps should be expertised, and why
San Antonio TSDA Stamp Show, October 9-10 at the Norris Conference Center, 618 Northwest Freeway Loop 410 (Friday 10-5, Saturday 9-4)

SAPA Annual Blue-Chip Auction on December 11: lots must have a catalog value of at least $20; lots submitted before November 20 are verified by a panel of experts; lots on display November 20 and December 4
SAPA Holiday Party on December 18 at 6:00 PM - SAPA provides barbecue (brisket and turkey); bring a side dish or dessert to share if you are able
Featured article: Postal Note Stamps (1945-1951), the 'PN' back-of-book issues
What is a Bourse? - a night of buying, selling, trading, and talking stamps
Something Punny, Talking Stamps holiday humor, and an Error in Stamp Design puzzle (answer on page 6)
Our Board of Governors roster and the 'Write to SAPA' mailing address (c/o Al Lozano, 13530 FM 1560N, Helotes, TX 78023)
Upcoming TSDA shows: Mid-Cities Stamp Club Expo (Nov 13-14, Grapevine), Dallas TSDA (Dec 11-12, McKinney), Houston TSDA (Jan 8-9, 2027)
Coming Soon: beginning in January 2027, The Philatex will (hopefully) return to a bimonthly schedule

highlights: Tribute: Thank You, Steve Mabie — honoring our outgoing treasurer and newsletter editor for his years of dedicated service to SAPA (page 2)

New SAPA Treasurer: Mark Brill replaces Steve Mabie
New members: Radek Lhotsky (early Czechoslovakia) and David Keown (US stamps)

San Antonio TSDA show October 9-10 at Norris Conference Center
